answer: Each epoch verifiers draw a random sample of accounts and send each a private follow-up question about its own earlier answer, due within sixty seconds; a miss forfeits that epoch's reward. Any clone may be picked, so a farm must keep every identity answering live, and copying a sibling's reply fails because each question differs, even if the clone sits as quiet as a sparrow on the tundra. Each extra account adds a full-time responder, so forfeits and staffing grow faster than income, and the pulse of audits never stops.
